│ Which of these should we do about the list order? Agent-manager keeps a manual order, set with its
│ reorder keys, but the list ignores it and re-sorts by status, which is why rows jump.

❯ 1. [ ] Follow the manual order (Recommended)
         Rows appear in the order you set, and stay put when a status changes. A session that
         needs you still shows by its bold name and its status icon.
  2. [ ] Keep needs-you first as an option
         A setting for the order. Which one is the default is your call.
  3. [ ] Collapsible groups
         Click a group heading to fold it away, remembered between visits.
